payload.name: Group Cohesion
payload.fact: Group cohesion is positively associated with performance in weak-link coordination games, with high-cohesion groups being more likely to achieve superior equilibria.
payload.boundary: Team production settings using weak-link coordination games.

provenance.title: Measuring "Group Cohesion" to Reveal the Power of Social Relationships in Team Production
provenance.quote_or_locus: A series of experiments, including a pre-registered replication, reveals strong positive associations between group cohesion and performance assessed in weak-link coordination games, with high-cohesion groups being very likely to achieve superior equilibria

provenance.title: Measuring "Group Cohesion" to Reveal the Power of Social Relationships in Team Production
provenance.quote_or_locus: In exploratory analysis, we identify beliefs rather than social preferences as the primary mechanism through which factors proxied by group cohesion influence group performance
